notes.title: Roots Need Control 3.0 in the DCCF!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I'm !CyberApex.
This notice is limited to the Korean, but it is explained in English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090378/722e324ac3eca945001180adb651beec3d4d551c.jpg[/img]

[b]Roots Need Control 3.0 will participate and exhibit in the "DCCF Indie Game Special Exhibition" held in Daegu Metropolitan City![/b]

The event will be held in Korea and will be held from October 6th to October 7th in Korean time.
Places and addresses are as follows.

[list]
[*]10, Exco-ro, Buk-gu, Daegu, Republic of Korea (Daegu EXCO)
[/list]

In addition, Roots Need Control's mini project "RNC Mini" will be on display.
If you visit Daegu, Korea, for the play of RNC 3.0 and RNC Mini, welcome!

Thank you for reading it. See you in Daegu.
- 09.06, !CyberApex

notes.title: Roots Need Controller
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090378/04f67058549a6ab4ecae5dd9192cf207516488a9.png[/img]

Roots Need Control 3.0 does not support game pads.
However, Steam Input has also made gameplay possible on RNC 3.0.

Introduces an input layout called [b]Roots Need Controller[/b].
[b]Roots Need Controller[/b] provides gameplay using gyro sensors.

For operating instructions, check the Steam Input setting.
[b]Currently, Roots Need Controller only supports dual-sense (PlayStation 5 controllers).[/b]
Support for the XBox controller is undecided, but we'll hurry.

Thank you!
- !CyberApex
